answer: The consensus layer utilizes a karst topology to enforce Sybil resistance by requiring agents to stake collateral within a distributed orchard of validated identity nodes. Each unique identifier necessitates a verifiable capital lockup proportional to its voting weight. This mechanism ensures that generating a vast ocean of fake identities incurs an insurmountable financial penalty. By tying influence to scarce economic assets, the network ensures that the cost of an attack scales linearly.
